unit.title: Helpers that act: steps, tools and asking first

lesson.title: A helper that does things
lesson.subtitle: Helpers that only talk, and helpers that use tools

video.title: A helper that does things
video.format_note: Animated explainer, 16:9, flat Darsi colours on paper-grey backgrounds, one recurring teacher character. Narration in the lesson language; captions as separate files, never burned in.
cast: Ms Amina Bello — primary teacher, Nigeria (main character)
Mr Joseph Mwangi — computer studies teacher, Kenya (cameo)
Narrator — the Darsi voice, talking to the student (warm, peer to peer)

chapters.label: A helper that made it up

scenes.visual: A list: Just chatting; Made it up!; How to check?.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: My phone can chat with me all day. But when I asked it about tomorrow’s weather, it just made up an answer! A real helper would go and check. But how?

scenes.animation: The Darsi mark pops in; the title slides up.
scenes.narration: Today: helpers that do things, not just talk.

scenes.visual: A list: You ask, it writes words back; It can’t check or do things.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Some AI helpers only talk. You ask, and they write words back. On their own, they can’t check anything or do anything.

scenes.visual: A list: Weather; Sums; Reminder; Helpers with tools: agents.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Other helpers can use tools. A tool is a small program that does one job: it tells the weather, does sums, or sets a reminder. These helpers are called agents.

scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: An agent is an AI helper that uses tools to get a job done. It listens, makes a plan, uses a tool, and then answers.

scenes.visual: A list: Listen: weather in Kafi tomorrow?; Plan: check the weather; Use the weather tool.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Darsi Tiny is a small helper that lives on a phone. I asked it: what’s the weather in Kafi tomorrow? First it made a plan: check the weather. Then it used the weather tool.

scenes.visual: A list: Sunny, 35°C, 10% rain; The helper answers with the facts; Checked, not guessed.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: The tool sent back the facts: sunny, thirty-five degrees, and a small chance of rain. Then Darsi Tiny answered with those facts. It didn’t guess: it checked!

scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Quick check! Which of these helpers is an agent that uses a tool?

scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: The weather helper. It uses a tool to check, then answers from what the tool said. Telling a joke or saying hello needs no tool at all.

scenes.visual: A list: Pick a question; Tap One step; Watch each step; Ask a grown-up first.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: In the app, pick a question and tap One step. Watch the plan, the tool and the answer appear, one by one. Ask a grown-up first, because the helper downloads once.

scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Your turn. A helper says it will be sunny tomorrow, but it never used the weather tool. Should you believe it?

scenes.visual: Summary points: Some helpers only talk; Agents use tools; Listen, plan, tool, answer.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.on_screen_text: Some helpers only talk · Agents use tools · Listen, plan, tool, answer
scenes.narration: Not yet: it didn’t check with a tool. Remember: some helpers only talk, while agents use tools. An agent listens, plans, uses a tool, then answers.

scenes.visual: A list: Play “Helper and Tool”; Make a plan; Ask the timetable tool; Answer from the tool.
scenes.animation: Each item arrives as it is said.
scenes.narration: Try it yourself: play Helper and Tool with a friend. Your friend asks about the class timetable. You make a plan, then ask the tool: someone holding the timetable. Then answer from what the tool said!

checkpoints.prompt: Which of these helpers is an agent that uses a tool?

options.text: A helper that tells you a joke
A helper that uses the weather tool, then answers

checkpoints.feedback_correct: Correct — it uses the weather tool to check, then answers from what the tool said.
checkpoints.feedback_wrong: Not quite — a joke or a hello needs no tool. The weather helper uses a tool to check.

checkpoints.prompt: A helper says it will be sunny tomorrow, but it never used the weather tool. Should you believe it?

options.text: Not yet: it didn’t check with a tool

checkpoints.feedback_correct: Correct — without the weather tool, it is only guessing. A good helper checks with a tool first.
checkpoints.feedback_wrong: Not quite — sounding sure isn’t checking. Without the weather tool, it is only guessing.
